what_this_is: The RECUT record for the EC6 end-of-life (ABEX) repair. It supersedes the falsified-text inventory this directory held before (still in git history at c5c41341) and records what was actually changed: the lesson text in this repo, and the 113 live question rows a later migration must update. Every OLD string here was read out of the LIVE production rows, not out of a bank file.
engines: engines main 709172f, vendored in packages/engines (economics/fdp/economics.js and scenarioCalculations.js)
digest: /root/ec-wip-fdp/digest.txt at 534 lines, rebuilt by ec6_dump.mjs from the repaired lab; every number written in this recut is a line of that digest

verification_of_every_OLD_string.method: The 396 live rows were dumped from production (project txcsbtvcdaqmkjjbhbeg, public.academy_quiz_questions where app_slug = fdp) with supabase db query --linked, and compared field by field with the five applied 20260918 seed migrations.
verification_of_every_OLD_string.why_it_matters: The migration that follows can guard each UPDATE on the OLD text and know it will match exactly one live row.

against_the_floor.actually_recut: 34 of 78 lessons, 113 of 396 questions, 31 with the keyed option itself rewritten
against_the_floor.note: The floor was read off the applied seed SQL and was exactly right on the lessons: all 34 it named needed work and no lesson outside its list did. Seven questions moved that it did not list. Five are falsified text it missed, each carrying a retired rate or a retired ABEX claim inside a distractor or an explanation rather than a moved NPV, which a value-based sweep cannot see: advanced final exam ord 33, advanced m06 ord 4, beginner m05 ord 5, intermediate final exam ord 26 and intermediate m04 ord 9. One is a defect this wave found that predates the repair: advanced final exam ord 28 offered 179.5082 percent, a figure that is in no digest line at all, and numsweep flags it as an unresolved literal. One carries no change of meaning: advanced m01 ord 7, where a distractor was lengthened to clear the answer-length rank gate after the rewrites in that bank. The sweep that found the five resolves every numeric literal in the corpus against the rebuilt digest, so a retired rate with no replacement value shows up as unresolved rather than as a moved number.

Each asserted a rate, a status or a headline IRR the engine no longer returns. Four of them were rebuilt around what the engine does return rather than patched.
